gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-inria-sans: Inria Sans has tubular strokes, like bent copper pipe, and gaps you can see through. And Comic Relief takes the top spot with lines that never vary and bowls left unfinished on one side, which is the pair's whole charm.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-istok-web: Stems and arches of identical thickness give Comic Relief a bold, commanding look, while Istok Web underneath turns rounded, with one clearly open side. Paragraphs run smooth and friendly.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-jost: Loud and unfinished, that's Comic Relief, with bowls left open on one side. But Jost keeps a plain sans line beneath it, broad at the terminals, so the heading's boldness has somewhere quiet to land.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-jura: Jura draws its strokes as constant as bent wire, with s curves that open wide at both ends, so it sits cleanly under a bold heading. Long paragraphs read smooth and unfussy.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-k2d: Comic Relief leads with bold, commanding strokes and bowls left unfinished on one side. Then K2D follows in a sans with tube-like thickness through every bend, and its c terminals hang far from the bowl.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kanchenjunga: Kanchenjunga holds the steady line of a technical drafting pen, with shapes that never clog at low resolution. Kanchenjunga as a sans-serif body gives the pair its strongest quality: a loud heading backed by a precise one.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kantumruy-pro: Big, bold and slightly unfinished, Comic Relief is hard to ignore. Kantumruy Pro, a sans-serif with hairline-free letterforms and an e opening clearly to the right, would look oddly crowded if the heading were shrunk down to its size.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kodchasan: Strokes that never vary, plus bowls left unfinished on one side, make Comic Relief bold and commanding. Kodchasan answers underneath as a plain sans with terminals that hang open and no calligraphic thinning.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-koho: KoHo reads clean and neutral as a plain sans, with wide c apertures that keep each word easy to scan. But Comic Relief earns its keep big and short, where its unbroken line and unfinished bowls can show off.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kosugi: Kosugi has an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers. Its wire-bent look runs across whole words in a clean sans, while Comic Relief above it stays bold and commanding with bowls left open on one side.
